title: 〜に比べて / 〜に比べ
simpleExplanation: 〜に比べて sets up a comparison openly: 去年に比べて今年は暑い = compared to last year, this year is hot. The noun before に比べて is the standard you compare against; the main clause says how the other thing differs. It is more explicit than the plain particle より.
whenUsed: Essays, reports, presentations with data, everyday comparisons. Variants: 〜に比べると, 〜と比べて, written 〜に比べ.
formation: Noun + に比べて / に比べると / に比べ

rows.label: B に比べて A は〜
cells: 去年に比べて今年は暑い

rows.label: A は B ほど〜ない
cells: 今年は去年ほど暑くない

examples.ja: 去年に比べて、今年は暑い。
examples.reading: きょねんにくらべて、ことしはあつい。
examples.en: Compared to last year, this year is hot.
examples.note: Standard (last year) + the difference (this year is hot).

examples.ja: 東京に比べると、大阪は物価が安い。
examples.reading: とうきょうにくらべると、おおさかはぶっかがやすい。
examples.en: Compared with Tokyo, prices in Osaka are cheaper.
examples.note: に比べると: the same meaning with a conditional feel.

examples.ja: 兄は弟に比べて、ずっとおとなしい。
examples.reading: あにはおとうとにくらべて、ずっとおとなしい。
examples.en: Compared to his younger brother, the older one is much quieter.

examples.ja: 田舎は都会に比べて、家賃がずっと安い。
examples.reading: いなかはとかいにくらべて、やちんがずっとやすい。
examples.en: Compared to the city, rent in the countryside is much cheaper.

examples.ja: 以前に比べ、この製品の性能は大幅に向上した。
examples.reading: いぜんにくらべ、このせいひんのせいのうはおおはばにこうじょうした。
examples.en: Compared with before, this product's performance has improved greatly.
examples.note: Written form に比べ in a report.

similarGrammar.difference: The simple comparative particle. に比べて makes the comparison a topic of the sentence.
A is not as … as B: comparison of inferiority.
"For a…": expectation vs reality, not a comparison between two items.

commonMistakes.wrong: 去年を比べて、今年は暑い。
commonMistakes.right: 去年に比べて、今年は暑い。
commonMistakes.why: The standard of comparison takes に (or と), not を.

commonMistakes.wrong: 昔に比べて、今は便利ではない。(intended: not as convenient)
commonMistakes.right: 今は昔ほど便利ではない。
commonMistakes.why: "Not as X as" is expressed by ほど〜ない; に比べて + a negative sounds odd unless you mean a plain contrast.

commonMistakes.wrong: 兄が背が高いに比べて
commonMistakes.right: 兄が背が高いのに比べて
commonMistakes.why: A clause needs の before に比べて.

usageNotes: Variants: 〜に比べると / 〜と比べて / 〜に比べ (written). 〜より is the plain comparative particle; に比べて makes the comparison explicit.
Statistics-style sentences often use 〜に比べて〜パーセント増加した.
jlptTips: A comparison adjective (高い, 安い, 多い) plus a second item in the sentence = に比べて.
If the blank precedes a clause + の, the answer is のに比べて; check for the の.
Distractors: に対して (contrast of two different features), にしては (unexpected), より (grammatical but usually not the intended answer when both appear).
